review_comment: The code exposes the Python 'self' object to JavaScript without demonstrated access controls, allowing potential arbitrary method calls from web content. Implement method filtering to expose only safe, intended methods to the JavaScript context, or remove the exposure if not required for functionality.

The added JavaScript execution receives user-controlled target and known_targets parameters without validation. While the data flows through JSON serialization, the calibre_extract.show_footnote function may unsafely incorporate this data into the DOM. Validate and sanitize target and known_targets parameters before JSON serialization, or ensure calibre_extract.show_footnote properly encodes output for the DOM context.

The patch comments out private browsing configuration, removing session isolation between web views. While other security settings remain, this change weakens privacy protections. Re-enable private browsing or document the specific technical justification for disabling this security feature.
